deathDayLines.line: — DAY 7 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown nuts went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
Stefano Gallo reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Gina — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
Pedro mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
The stash count is off. 2 stones missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.

💧 Gina returns with 8L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan telling A man, maybe 20s, with a long braid about Jason. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Elena telling A woman, maybe 30s about Jason. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut telling A woman, maybe 30s about Pedro. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s telling A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut about Elena. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
A person, maybe 30s heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
💧 Jason returns with water: +4 clean.
A woman, maybe 30s sets out to find Gina. "Won't be long."
🩹 A is hurting (7 HP) — Jason patches them up before they head out. (7 → 32 HP)
🎒 A man, maybe 20s, with a long braid shoulders a pack. "Going far this time. Don't wait up."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.

You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

While you were gone — one thing you missed:
🩸 The something displaced a LOT of water mauled Priya (-24 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.

📨 Word came: Giulia Bianchi wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: Giulia Bianchi applied remotely.

🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, a crow that watches too long and blinks too little, something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, a crow that watches too long and blinks too little, something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

📓 Journal: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, a crow that watches too long and blinks too little, something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log, the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still at the door, day 7.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Journal: Counter: Strike the head as it coils — When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap.

🛡️ the person in their 30s, Elena, Thabo and the man in his 40s, with a farmer's tan met them at the door — 3 driven off, 1 barely walked away. the person in their 30s, Elena, Thabo, the man in his 40s, with a farmer's tan are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
🌟 THE SKY SPLITS OPEN.
Not with light. With... interface. Windows scrolling across the clouds, too fast to read.
A voice behind your eyes — bright, delighted, utterly wrong. (The System has arrived.)
🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
📻 "Why do the small humans keep putting organic matter in their FACE-HOLES? We built you a fusion pellet! ...You BURIED it. WHY did you bury the pellet?!"
📖 Your journal shimmers — handwriting dissolving into interface. It talks now. It remembers everything.
🕐 Your hand-drawn time-circle glitches — and something colder, more precise, takes its place. (We kept the smudges. They're charming.)
🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 The village gathers. Everyone's journal is changing. Everyone hears the voice. Silas grabs your arm. "Tell me you hear that too."
🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
"We've auto-enrolled your current traveling companions: Silas! You're welcome! (They can leave anytime. Probably.)"
"Choose wisely! Or don't! Betrayal arcs test VERY well with our demographics!"
A new option appears when you look at people: invite them to your party.
💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 20. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 2."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Anh learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 2)

SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.

★ IDENTIFIED: Huckleberry. Small dark berries, mountain slopes. Bears love them. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.
Stefano was watching. Now they know Huckleberry too.
📚 Village knowledge: Sam taught everyone about Huckleberry. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

Elena drew Hickory Nuts in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

Farid spends the afternoon with the small tree with mitten-shaped leaves (three shapes), spicy root smell — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. By evening farid is thoroughly, educationally sick. "NOT food," they announce to the fire, pale. "My body told me so." The lesson is learned the hard way — and now the whole village knows it.
From the lumped bag: Sassafras — named, and out.

⚔ THE MODERATOR! You're on your own.

It comes apart — no one in reach, no one chasing. The fight ends; they melt back into the wilds.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)
